chemistry.notes: Estimated: The Weekly Driver covers the 2023-2025 Niro EV (CATL NCM, 64.8 kWh); the 2026 Niro EV keeps the same 64.8 kWh pack (Kia Canada / Guide Auto).

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: EV Database (Niro EV 2022-2025) lists automatic preconditioning when using navigation; Kia says conditioning is standard on the second-generation Niro EV (Europe). No Niro EV manual page showing a manual switch was found, so only the navigation trigger is recorded. 2026 is the same generation; no change found.

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: EV Database lists 64.8 kWh usable / 68.0 kWh nominal for the Niro EV 2022-2025; Nyland measured 64.3 kWh usable. The 2026 Niro EV keeps the same 64.8 kWh pack (Kia Canada / Guide Auto), no change found. Kia's own 64.8 kWh is a bare figure.

capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Estimated: EV Database 68.0 kWh nominal for the 2022-2025 Niro EV; same pack in 2026.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: The Weekly Driver gives 358 V nominal (400-volt class) for the 2023-2025 Niro EV pack (CATL NCM); the 2026 car has the same pack.

dc_max_kw.notes: Estimated: Kia states no car peak; its 10-80 % in 43 min is on an 85 kW charger, Kia Ireland lists 43 min at both 100 and 300 kW, and CarExpert AU (search excerpt) lists 83.8 kW, so the 2023-2025 car is limited near 85 kW. Same hardware in 2026. EV Database/EVKX list 94 kW (see the second value).
EV Database: max DC 94 kW for the Niro EV 2022-2025 (EVKX also 94 kW); probably above what the car sustains, see the 85 kW entry.

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: InsideEVs gives an 11 kW onboard charger for the 2023 Niro EV (EV Database also 11 kW; the unlinked Chargeprice import agreed); no onboard charger change found for 2026. Kia Ireland lists 7.2 kW single-phase / 11 kW three-phase.
